```{r}
dat_filt <- s2_spatmean %>% 
  filter(PlotLayout %in% c('Spoke')) %>% 
    dplyr::select(EvaluationID,year, season,metric,interannual_mean,interannual_sd ) %>% 
 left_join(
    indicators %>% 
      mutate(year = year(mdy_hms(FieldEvalDate))) %>% 
      dplyr::select(
        EvaluationID,year,TotalFoliarCover,AH_BasalCover:BareOrganicMaterialCover,)
    ) %>% 
    left_join(
      RW_FHMetrics_2022_2023 %>% 
        dplyr::select(EvaluationID,FH_ShrubCover,FH_TreeCover,FH_PerennialCover,FH_AnnualCover,FH_WoodyCover,FH_NonwoodyCover) %>% 
        mutate(FH_PFG = FH_PerennialCover-FH_WoodyCover, FH_allCover= FH_WoodyCover + FH_NonwoodyCover)
    ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(season, metric), values_from=c(interannual_mean,interannual_sd)) 

mod <- dat_filt %>%
  #filter(AdminState=='MT') %>%
  lm(formula = AH_HydroFACCover ~ 
     # Main effects
     interannual_mean_amj_ndvi * interannual_mean_jas_ndvi +
     interannual_mean_amj_ndwi * interannual_mean_jas_ndwi +
     interannual_sd_amj_ndvi * interannual_sd_jas_ndvi +
     interannual_sd_amj_ndwi * interannual_sd_jas_ndwi +
     # Cross-interactions between means
     interannual_mean_amj_ndvi * interannual_mean_amj_ndwi +
     interannual_mean_jas_ndvi * interannual_mean_jas_ndwi +
     # Cross-interactions between SDs
     interannual_sd_amj_ndvi * interannual_sd_amj_ndwi +
     interannual_sd_jas_ndvi * interannual_sd_jas_ndwi+ 
    # Cross-interactions between ndvi means and SDs
     interannual_mean_jas_ndvi * interannual_sd_jas_ndvi,
     data = .)
#  lm(data = .,FH_WoodyCover~interannual_mean_amj_ndvi+interannual_mean_jas_ndvi+interannual_sd_amj_ndvi +interannual_sd_jas_ndvi)

summary(mod)
plot(mod)

# Calculate confidence intervals for the mean response
conf_intervals <- predict(mod, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)

# Calculate prediction intervals for new observations
pred_intervals <- predict(mod, interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)

# Add these to your original data
results <- dat_filt %>%
  mutate(
    # Confidence intervals
    fit = conf_intervals[,"fit"],
    conf_lwr = conf_intervals[,"lwr"],
    conf_upr = conf_intervals[,"upr"],
    # Prediction intervals
    pred_lwr = pred_intervals[,"lwr"],
    pred_upr = pred_intervals[,"upr"]
  )

# View the first few rows of results
head(results)

# To get a summary of the intervals
summary_stats <- results %>%
  summarise(
    mean_conf_width = mean(conf_upr - conf_lwr),
    mean_pred_width = mean(pred_upr - pred_lwr),
    max_conf_width = max(conf_upr - conf_lwr),
    max_pred_width = max(pred_upr - pred_lwr)
  )

print(summary_stats)
```

```{r}
# Modified function to accept response variable
generate_pred_data <- function(data, model, var_name, response_var) {
  # Create prediction grid
  pred_data <- data.frame(x = seq(min(data[[var_name]]), max(data[[var_name]]), length.out = 100))
  names(pred_data) <- var_name
  
  # Add mean values for all other predictors
  model_vars <- names(coef(model))[-1]  # exclude intercept
  for(v in model_vars) {
    if(!v %in% names(pred_data)) {
      pred_data[[v]] <- mean(data[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  # Get predictions
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = pred_data, interval = "confidence")
  pred_int <- predict(model, newdata = pred_data, interval = "prediction")
  
  # Combine predictions
  pred_data$fit <- preds[,"fit"]
  pred_data$conf_lwr <- preds[,"lwr"]
  pred_data$conf_upr <- preds[,"upr"]
  pred_data$pred_lwr <- pred_int[,"lwr"]
  pred_data$pred_upr <- pred_int[,"upr"]
  
  return(pred_data)
}

# Create plotting function with flexible response variable
plot_predictions <- function(data, model, response_var) {
  # Create plots for NDVI variables
  ndvi_plots <- list()
  ndvi_vars <- c("interannual_mean_amj_ndvi", "interannual_mean_jas_ndvi",
                 "interannual_sd_amj_ndvi", "interannual_sd_jas_ndvi")

  for(var in ndvi_vars) {
    pred_data <- generate_pred_data(data, model, var, response_var)
    
    p <- ggplot() +
      # Add actual data points
      geom_point(data = data, aes_string(x = var, y = response_var), 
                 alpha = 0.2, color = "gray50") +
      # Add prediction interval
      geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, 
                  aes(x = .data[[var]], ymin = pred_lwr, ymax = pred_upr),
                  fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.2) +
      # Add confidence interval
      geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, 
                  aes(x = .data[[var]], ymin = conf_lwr, ymax = conf_upr),
                  fill = "blue", alpha = 0.2) +
      # Add fitted line
      geom_line(data = pred_data, 
                aes(x = .data[[var]], y = fit),
                color = "blue", size = 1) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(y = gsub("_", " ", response_var),
           x = gsub("_", " ", var),
           title = paste("Relationship with", gsub("_", " ", var))) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
    
    ndvi_plots[[var]] <- p
  }

  # Create plots for NDWI variables
  ndwi_plots <- list()
  ndwi_vars <- c("interannual_mean_amj_ndwi", "interannual_mean_jas_ndwi",
                 "interannual_sd_amj_ndwi", "interannual_sd_jas_ndwi")

  for(var in ndwi_vars) {
    pred_data <- generate_pred_data(data, model, var, response_var)
    
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = data, aes_string(x = var, y = response_var), 
                 alpha = 0.2, color = "gray50") +
      geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, 
                  aes(x = .data[[var]], ymin = pred_lwr, ymax = pred_upr),
                  fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_ribbon(data = pred_data, 
                  aes(x = .data[[var]], ymin = conf_lwr, ymax = conf_upr),
                  fill = "green", alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_line(data = pred_data, 
                aes(x = .data[[var]], y = fit),
                color = "darkgreen", size = 1) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(y = gsub("_", " ", response_var),
           x = gsub("_", " ", var),
           title = paste("Relationship with", gsub("_", " ", var))) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10))
    
    ndwi_plots[[var]] <- p
  }

  # Combine all plots
  grid.arrange(
    grobs = c(ndvi_plots, ndwi_plots),
    ncol = 4,
    top = paste("Relationships between", gsub("_", " ", response_var), "and Predictors\n",
                "(Blue/Green bands: Confidence intervals, Light blue/green bands: Prediction intervals)")
  )
}

# Example usage:
# For TotalFoliarCover
plot_predictions(dat_filt, mod, "AH_HydroFACCover")

# For a different response variable (assuming you've fit a model with a different response):
# plot_predictions(dat_filt, different_model, "DifferentResponseVariable")
```
